teamFindings.finding: Trevor Lawrence is not listed. Hamilton and Murray are on IR; Tuten and Walker are questionable for Thursday and remain inactive-list inputs.
Joe Fagnano is the confirmed Thursday starter; Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley are out. Hawkins is out and Wiggins is questionable.
Joe Burrow remains expected. The Madrid estimated report and secondary/pass-rush cluster were recorded; final designations remain pending.
Madrid travel and the estimated Wednesday report were reviewed. Ebukam is on IR; Branch DNP, Robinson and Deablo limited, and Pearce workload remains unresolved.
Bo Nix remains expected. Bryant return-to-practice and the Hufanga/Jones secondary cluster were recorded without treating the return window as activation.
Bryce Young practiced full. The interim defensive-coordinator change and the Lewis/Moton/front-seven availability chain were recorded; final roles remain unresolved.
Dak Prescott remains expected. The OL, secondary, TE/WR and Turpin multi-role practice cluster was recorded without converting DNP/limited to a final status.
Daniel Jones remains the named starter. Current absences and the prior Nelson/Buckner replacement chains require active-week role revalidation.
Wilson concussion/DNP, Hall limited and Mitchell IR were recorded; expected availability was not converted into a final status.
Patrick Mahomes practiced full. Kelce/Rice and the front-seven practice statuses remain preliminary and no role allocation was inferred.
Jared Goff remains expected. The center, linebacker, edge and secondary practice cluster was recorded; no exact replacement was inferred.
Willis full, Wright DNP and the multi-player front-seven/secondary limited cluster were recorded as preliminary availability only.
Deshaun Watson is in concussion protocol and the starter is unresolved. The OL/front-seven practice cluster remains preliminary.
The run-game leadership change, Kamara DNP, return-to-practice cases and kicker change were recorded; return windows do not prove activation.
The post-bye Wednesday report records Skattebo DNP, both starting tackles limited and Carter illness; finals remain pending.
Joe Milton is the named starter, replacing Tanner McKee. The Barkley/receiver and defensive practice absences remain preliminary.
Watson season-ending and McDuffie DNP were recorded; Garrett/Ferguson return windows do not establish activation or restored roles.
Kinlaw/Payne/McNichols IR, Daniels full and the McLaurin committee availability change were recorded; replacement allocation must reopen.
C.J. Stroud remains expected. Bye-rest context and the Blankenship/Montgomery/Braden Smith preliminary report were recorded.
The Wednesday preliminary report shows a multi-player secondary/front cluster; no clean replacement chain or final designation was inferred.
Porter DNP and the defensive-tackle limited cluster were recorded from the Wednesday preliminary report; final roles remain unresolved.
Post-bye McCaffrey/Evans/Deebo DNP and Kirk limited were recorded; return-to-practice cases do not prove activation.
Jordan Love remains expected. Parsons returned limited and the Rhyan/Glover OL cluster remains unresolved pending final availability and role evidence.
The Wednesday report records Brown, Henry, Henderson and Barmore DNP with OL/secondary limitations; Maye was full. Finals remain pending.
Gardner Minshew is the officially named starter. Jeremiyah Love and Kendrick Bourne are on IR; the Wednesday OL/playmaker report remains preliminary.
Sam Darnold is out and Drew Lock is the named starter but was limited. Cross/Shaheed and OL/defensive-line inputs require current-week handling.
Baker Mayfield practiced full. Egbuka/Diaby DNP and other Wednesday statuses remain preliminary.
Caleb Williams remains expected. Short-rest travel and current RB/DL availability were recorded; Wednesday DNP/limited labels are not final designations.
The Monday-game Week 9 practice report was not yet filed. Palmer hamstring and the Gardner-Johnson secondary vacancy remain explicit unresolved inputs.
The Monday-game injury report was not yet filed. Kyler Murray hamstring and Darrisaw availability remain unresolved and fail closed.

byeTeamFindings.finding: Official bye-week reporting and the prior Week 8 injury phase were reviewed. Pittman remains on IR and the prior defensive-back cases require the next active report; no Week 9 fair exists to revise.
Official roster moves record the Simmons trade. The club entered the bye with unresolved OL and skill-position absences; these remain next-matchup context and do not alter a Week 9 fair.
